'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 western Russia attacks]]
***[[Russia]] says that it shot down two [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|aerial drones]] over the north and west of [[Crimea]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/8/28/russia-ukraine-war-live-drone-downed-near-moscow-air-traffic-suspended?update=2335200 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[2023 Ukrainian counteroffensive]]
***[[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant crisis]]
****The [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] warns that [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukraine]]'s [[offensive (military)|offensive]] in [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]] has increased the risk of damage to the [[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/8/28/russia-ukraine-war-live-drone-downed-near-moscow-air-traffic-suspended?update=2335551 (Al Jazeera)]
***Ukraine claims they retook the village of [[Robotyne]], Zaporizhzhia Oblast from the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]]. [[Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation|Russia]] says they have repelled attacks in the area. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-it-has-liberated-southeastern-village-robotyne-2023-08-28/ (Reuters)]
**[[Russia–United States relations]]
***Russia's [[Federal Security Service]] charges Robert Shonov, a former [[U.S.]] [[consulate]] employee, with passing information on Russia's [[2022 Russian mobilization|mobilization]] campaign to [[Embassy of the United States, Moscow|U.S. embassy staffers]] in [[Moscow]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/8/28/russia-ukraine-war-live-drone-downed-near-moscow-air-traffic-suspended?update=2335023 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mali War]]
**[[Malian Air Force]] jets bomb the town of [[Anefif]], attempting to strike [[Coordination of Azawad Movements]] troops, but miss. [https://www.barrons.com/news/mali-ex-rebels-accuse-army-of-new-strikes-on-its-positions-dd49dc63 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**The [[Government of Mexico|Mexican government]] says that it has deployed 1,200 more [[Mexican Armed Forces|troops]] to the [[Mexico|Mexican]] state of [[Michoacán]] after drug cartel violence has been reported over the weekend. [https://abcnews.go.com/Business/wireStory/mexico-sends-1200-troops-michoacan-state-after-weekend-102633665 (ABC News)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021-present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Tatmadaw|Military forces]] clash with the [[Internal conflict in Myanmar|insurgent]] [[Ta'ang National Liberation Army]] in northern [[Shan State]], [[Myanmar]], following reinforcements to the area in recent days. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/tnla-reports-heavy-fighting-near-myanmar-china-border.html (The Irrawaddy)]
*[[South Thailand insurgency]]
**Two defence volunteers and a policeman are killed, and five other officers are wounded, during an [[ambush]] in [[Yarang district]], [[Pattani province]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2637905 (Bangkok Post)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**Head of the [[Rapid Support Forces]] [[Hemedti|Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo]] publishes a 10-point plan that proposes a non-symmetrical [[federal system]] and a new apolitical [[Sudanese Army]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/28/sudans-rsf-floats-peace-plan-as-rival-army-chief-eyes-regional-trip (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2020–2023 Chinese property sector crisis]]
**Trading of [[Evergrande Group|Evergrande]] resumes on the [[Hong Kong Stock Exchange]] after a 17-month suspension with the company confirming its compliance with financial information disclosure and listing regulations. [https://www.philstar.com/business/2023/08/28/2292014/china-developer-evergrande-resumes-trading-hong-kong (AFP via ''The Philippine Star'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three people are killed and two others are injured in a [[Structural integrity and failure|building collapse]] in [[Ismailia]], [[Egypt]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/1235/507352/Egypt/Urban--Transport/Three-people-killed,-two-injured-in-building-colla.aspx (''Al-Ahram'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran]] says it has reached an agreement with [[Iraq]] to disarm and relocate [[Kurds|Kurdish]] rebels in northern Iraq and shut down bases run by the groups in the semi-autonomous region. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/28/iran-says-deal-agreed-with-iraq-for-disarming-relocation-of-kurdish-rebels (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Iraq]]
**[[Iraq]] announces the [[hanging|execution by hanging]] of three members of the [[Islamic State]] for the [[2016 Karrada bombing]] which killed hundreds of people. [https://www.barrons.com/news/iraq-hangs-3-for-is-claimed-blast-that-killed-hundreds-ceea2243 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Polish railway cyberattack]]
**[[Poland]] arrests sixteen people on suspicion of spying for [[Russia]] in relation to a [[cyberattack]] on [[Rail transport in Poland|Polish railways]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2023/08/28/poland-railway-disruptions-arrest/ff7847d8-45d2-11ee-b76b-0b6e5e92090d_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*A [[Judiciary of Chile|Chilean court]] upholds the prison sentences ranging from eight to 25 years for seven former [[Chilean Armed Forces|soldiers]] involved in the 1973 murder of singer [[Víctor Jara]], which occurred after the [[1973 Chilean coup d'état|coup d'état]] that ushered in [[Augusto Pinochet]]'s [[Military dictatorship of Chile (1973–1990)|dictatorship]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/chilean-court-sends-ex-soldiers-aged-73-85-jail-over-decades-old-murder-3731026 (AFP via CNA)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Guatemalan general election]]
**The Registry of Citizens of the [[Supreme Electoral Tribunal (Guatemala)|Supreme Electoral Tribunal]] suspends the legal personality of [[Semilla (political party)|Movimiento Semilla]], the party of President-elect [[Bernardo Arévalo]]. [https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/elecciones-generales-guatemala-2023/registro-de-ciudadanos-suspende-provisionalmente-la-inscripcion-de-la-personalidad-juridica-del-partido-movimiento-semilla-breaking/ (''Prensa Libre'')]
*[[2024 Taiwanese presidential election]]
**[[Foxconn]] founder [[Terry Gou]] announces that he will run as an [[Independent politician|independent]] in next year's presidential election on a platform of restoration of positive [[Cross-Strait relations]] and closer business ties. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/28/foxconn-billionaire-terry-gou-announces-taiwan-presidential-bid (Al Jazeera)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup]]
**[[Cape Verde men's national basketball team|Cape Verde]] and [[South Sudan men's national basketball team|South Sudan]], who both make their [[FIBA Basketball World Cup|World Cup]] debut, score their first-ever wins at the tournament. After first-round losses to [[Georgia men's national basketball team|Georgia]] and [[Puerto Rico men's national basketball team|Puerto Rico]], the African teams defeat [[Venezuela men's national basketball team|Venezuela]] and [[China men's national basketball team|China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/fiba-basketball-world-cup-africa-south-sudan-cape-verde-44c0fdbb0dfbc22f074eaffef2a12d26 (AP)]
